cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(cheryl_console_sdk_consumer LANGUAGES CXX)
    find_package(Cheryl 4 CONFIG REQUIRED)
    enable_testing()
endif()
foreach(required IN ITEMS Cheryl::Console Cheryl::ConsoleModel Cheryl::ConsoleRuntime)
    if(NOT TARGET ${required})
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Independent console consumer requires ${required}")
    endif()
endforeach()
add_executable(sdk-console main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(sdk-console PRIVATE Cheryl::ConsoleModel Cheryl::ConsoleRuntime)
if(TARGET Cheryl::ConsoleRmlUi)
    target_sources(sdk-console PRIVATE view.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sdk-console PRIVATE Cheryl::ConsoleRmlUi)
endif()
if(UNIX OR WIN32)
    add_test(NAME sdk-console COMMAND sdk-console "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fixtures" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/reports")
    set_tests_properties(sdk-console PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 90 LABELS "sdk;console;independent;scenarios")
else()
    message(STATUS "sdk-console report I/O requires POSIX or Windows drive-path support")
endif()
